title: HateCOT: An Explanation-Enhanced Dataset for Generalizable Offensive Speech Detection via Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating zero-shot and few-shot classification performance (Macro F1 scores) on diverse hate speech datasets, and assessing the LLMs' ability to correctly identify targeted racial/ethnic groups in their generated explanations (Target Identification).

Evaluating zero-shot and few-shot classification performance (Macro F1 scores) on diverse hate speech datasets, and assessing the LLMs' ability to correctly identify targeted gender identities or sexes in their generated explanations (Target Identification).
